title: CAMC for the Air Conditioner units installed at Museums & Inspection Quarter at Mahabalipuam Lighthouse under Chennai Directorate
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for a one-year comprehensive annual maintenance contract for 16 air conditioners in the heritage museum, maritime museum, inspection quarter and reception centre at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Mahabalipuram Lighthouse (Heritage Museum, Maritime Museum, Inspection Quarter, Reception centre)

scope.item: Heritage Museum - front pathway AC, 5 star, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Voltas
Heritage Museum - left side pathway AC, 5 star, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Voltas
Heritage Museum - right side pathway AC, 5 star, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Voltas
Heritage Museum - back side pathway AC, 5 star, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Voltas
Heritage Museum - centre 2 ton cassette type AC, copper coil, Voltas
Maritime Museum - left side room AC, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Voltas
Maritime Museum - right side room AC, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Voltas
Maritime Museum - centre room AC, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Voltas
Maritime Museum - front pathway AC, 5 star, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Voltas
Maritime Museum - back side pathway AC, 5 star, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Voltas
Inspection Quarter - hall AC, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Hitachi
Inspection Quarter - bed room AC, 1.5 ton, copper coil, Hitachi
Reception centre AC, 1.5 ton, copper coil, LG

money.notes: No estimate or EMD printed. Payment quarterly (25% of order value) after completion of quarterly services, bills to Navigational Assistant Grade-1, Mahabalipuram Lighthouse. Rates inclusive of labour, materials, transport. Number of units may vary.

period.completion: One year from work order; renewable for a further 2 years annually subject to performance

specs: Monthly maintenance service in first week of each month; breakdown calls attended immediately; service register and reports
CAMC covers replacement of all parts except condensing coil, compressor and enclosure; includes gas recharging
Units: Voltas 1.5 ton split (mostly 5 star) and 2 ton cassette, Hitachi 1.5 ton, LG 1.5 ton

documents.file: CAMC of AC at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse.pdf

notes: Scanned NIQ: cover notice, Annexure A schedule (rates blank; 16 units in 13 lines) and Annexure B terms. Quotations due 10.06.2024 15:00; no opening date printed. 'Mahabalipuam' misspelt in notice and listing.
